context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 83 validated: (1) Rate-limits on /feedback/submit (5/300s), /news/report (10/600s), /news/push/subscribe (20/60s) - all per-user via user_id. 429 response includes Retry-After header and 'Rate limit exceeded: N/Xs' detail. (2) GET /api/admin/audit/system returns {entries:[], total} with filters: category (capabilities|session|alert), action (force_logout|health_alert|...). Admin-only (403 else). Limit capped at 500. Sorted timestamp desc. (3) Force-logout creates audit entry with category='session', action='force_logout', IP from request.client.host (or x-forwarded-for), user_agent from headers. (4) Health-alert creates audit entry with category='alert', action='health_alert', actor_id='system', details containing subject/severity/emails/pushes/recipients. (5) cron_idle_minutes config: default 90, 0 disables. Rule fires when maintenance_runs last tick > cron_idle_minutes. (6) Frontend: data-testid='system-audit-panel' with 'audit-category-filter', 'audit-action-filter', 'audit-refresh-btn', 'audit-entry-{id}' rows. Mobile dropdown includes System-Audit. (7) data-testid='alerts-cron-idle-input' in HealthDashboard AlertSettings. BUG FIXED: health_alerts.py cron_idle rule had timezone-naive vs aware datetime comparison - fixed by ensuring tick_ts has tzinfo.
